meta.disclaimer: Not legal advice. These are CMS ratings of hospitals against a national benchmark, computed from claims and infection reports. They are not findings about the care any patient received, and a rating of worse than the benchmark does not mean an error occurred. Claims and deadlines for a hospital injury are for your own counsel.
